_meta.rule: Ruling 11 (Bean, 2026-10-23): a block's own size setting overrules the 44px house minimum; a tap area fits its own shape. Each entry is a literal 44px floor in a block that has size settings, on an element none of those settings sizes, so 44px stays SGS's own default there.
_meta.key: block + the rule's selector (whitespace collapsed; a rule inside an @-block is prefixed with its at-rule heads) + the property; a render-code floor in includes/ is keyed by its file path
